ca-06081-bos-matter-95352.title:
Adopt a resolution: 

A)	Authorizing the County to apply for and accept its Transitional Housing Program (THP) allocation award in an amount not to exceed $242,910, as specified in the THP Allocation Acceptance Form in effect at the time this Resolution is adopted; and

B)	Authorizing and Directing the County, if THP funds remain available after the deadline for submitting a signed Allocation Acceptance Form and the County is eligible for an additional allocation, to accept additional THP funds in an amount authorized by the California Department of Housing and Community Development (Department), not to exceed $485,820 (“Additional THP Allocation”); and

C)	Authorizing the County to apply for and accept its Housing Navigation and Maintenance Program (HNMP) allocation award in an amount not to exceed $65,477, as specified in the HNMP Allocation Acceptance Form in effect at the time this Resolution is adopted; and

D)	Authorizing and Directing the County, if HNMP funds remain available after the deadline for submitting a signed Allocation Acceptance Form and the County is eligible for an additional allocation, to accept additional HNMP funds in an amount authorized by the Department, not to exceed $130,954 (“Additional HNMP Allocation”); and

E)	Authorizing the Human Services Agency Director, or their designee, to act on behalf of the County in connection with the THP allocation award and any Additional THP Allocation, and to enter into, execute, and deliver all documents necessary or appropriate to participate in THP and receive those funds, including a Standard Agreement and any amendments to those documents (collectively, “THP Allocation Award Documents”); and

F)	Authorizing the Human Services Agency Director, or their designee, to act on behalf of the County in connection with the HNMP allocation award and any Additional HNMP Allocation, and to enter into, execute, and deliver all documents necessary or appropriate to participate in HNMP and receive those funds, including a Standard Agreement and any amendments to those documents (collectively, “HNMP Allocation Award Documents”); and

G)	Affirming that the County shall comply with the terms and conditions of the THP and HNMP Allocation Award Documents and shall use all allocation funds, including any additional allocations, in accordance with the applicable Allocation Acceptance Forms, Allocation Award Documents and subsequent amendments, program requirements, and applicable laws; and

H)	Affirming that the County retains discretion to accept any or all THP and HNMP funds awarded to it.
